P2.why: MP P2: belay options are the large broken ledge or the base of the offwidth.
P2.text: Either on the sizable broken ledge, or a little higher at the foot of the offwidth where both third-pitch options start.

P11.why: MP P11: belay at the base of the chimney, scattered fixed pins.
P11.text: At the base of the chimney, among scattered fixed pins that should be backed up.

1.why: Blog P1: two-bolt station ~4 m down and right of the first chains; stored notes put the pitch end at the chains.
1.text: At the chains above the four-bolt slab; a two-bolt station also sits a few metres down and to the right of them.

2.why: Blog P2: belay on gear in the large left-facing corner (stored says below the roof-capped dihedral; compatible but slightly loose).
2.text: A gear belay inside the large left-facing corner.

4.why: Blog P4: two-bolt ledge after crossing a flake; 'juggy' not supported, removed.
4.text: On a two-bolt ledge, reached by moving right across a flake after returning to the corner.

7.why: Blog P7: two bolts on right side of the large ledge; second source calls it the best belay on the route.
7.text: On a large ledge, belaying from two bolts on its right side; the best stance on the route.

1.why: Source P1: semihanging stance on two bolts ~25 ft below the Lithuanian Lip.
1.text: A semi-hanging stance on two bolts, about 25 ft below the Lithuanian Lip.

2.why: Source P2: thin crack and bolts above the roof to another semihanging stance on bolts.
2.text: A semi-hanging stance on bolts, reached by following a thin crack and bolts above the Lip.

3.why: Source P3: single required free move to a stance with belay bolts.
3.text: At a bolted stance, reached after a single mandatory free move at the end of the pitch.

4.why: Source P4: beefy bolts on a small ledge.
4.text: On a small ledge with large bolts.

5.why: Source P5: exit right onto a small ledge with two bolts.
5.text: On a small ledge with two bolts, reached by exiting right.

6.why: Source P6: belay on top of the Rotten Block from two bolts; 'seat' unsupported, removed.
6.text: On top of the Rotten Block, anchored with two bolts.

12.why: Source numbering differs (its P12 is the Beckey Route final pitch, rappel anchor only mentioned as an option); 'on a steep wall' unsupported.

6.why: Source pillar P2 (stored P6, same grade/shuffle-left content; source numbering omits the 4 approach pitches): continue thin hands then hand crack to a better belay ledge; tiny ledge below.
6.text: On a ledge that is better than the tiny one below, above the thin hands and hand crack past the crux.
